title: བསྟན་འགྱུར། སྡེ་དགེ། ཚད་མ། པེ (Derge Tengyur, vol. 182)
shelf_note: Canonical Tibetan Buddhist epistemological treatise (Pramāṇa section) from the Derge Tengyur xylograph collection.

tr_errors_A.problem: Misinterprets the trailing verb phrase of a reductio argument continuing from the previous folio as an independent future declarative statement.
Translates the causative construction 'causes to apprehend / makes apprehended' as a simple active verb.

pages.prefer_reason: Translation B accurately renders technical Pramāṇa terminology with appropriate glosses and correctly handles the syntax of folio boundary fragments.

book_verdict: Clear, high-quality Derge Tengyur blockprint folio with an accurate transcription and an exceptionally precise, philosophically sound Translation B.
